about: Reviewed starting inputs for the font-gsub target. The first byte picks the lookup kind (value modulo 6: single, multiple, ligature, contextual, chained contextual, extension; bits 3 and 4 the extension's inner kind: single, multiple, ligature). Each pair of further bytes (up to 64 bytes) chooses one lookup: the glyphs of its band it covers and its format, outputs and context; bytes also choose the text. The font is built with 8 and 64 lookups.

seeds.why: single substitutions, format 2 lists (odd second bytes)
ligatures of two and three glyphs
contextual, formats 1, 2 and 3 by the second byte modulo 3
chained contextual with backtrack and lookahead
no choice bytes: every lookup from byte 0
